song.title: One Rock, One Pot
song.style: English, warm 60s soul with tambourine, punchy horns, groovy bass, organ and backing harmonies, warm friendly male lead vocal, feel-good, 118 BPM
song.lyrics:
[Verse]
Twelve floors of strangers on my street
We never talked, we'd never meet
Cold cereal for every meal
And just a screen to share my meal

[Chorus]
One rock, one pot, one spoon
Bring what you've got, we'll eat soon
One rock, one pot, come down
Best soup in the whole town

[Verse]
I tucked my phone in on the door
And set a pot on the courtyard floor
A carrot came, an onion too
A pumpkin rolled into the stew

[Chorus]
One rock, one pot, one spoon
Twelve floors singing the same tune
One rock, one pot, come down
Best soup in the whole town

shots.prompt: The camera swoops fast down the face of a tall red brick apartment building draped in green vines to {moss} sitting alone at a ground floor window. Bright morning light.
{moss} eats a spoonful of cereal while staring at a glowing phone propped against the milk carton. Close-up, the camera pushes in. Warm kitchen light.
{moss} and a tall man in an orange tracksuit with a big grey beard pass each other in a stairwell, both staring at phones, and bump shoulders. The camera whip pans between them. Warm stairwell light.
{moss} and a tall man in an orange tracksuit with a big grey beard mumble and look away awkwardly. Close-up, the camera crash zooms in on their faces. Warm stairwell light.
{moss} opens his fridge and finds it completely empty except for one lemon. The camera dolly zooms on his face. Warm fridge light.
A single lemon rolls slowly across an empty fridge shelf. Close-up, the camera tracks with it. Warm fridge light.
Close-up: {moss} sings to the camera, his mouth opening wide under his bushy mustache, holding a bowl of cereal, a little sad. The camera pushes in. Warm lamp light.
{moss} notices a big round grey rock holding his front door open. The camera whip pans to the rock. Warm daylight.
Close-up: {moss} sings to the camera, his mouth opening wide under his bushy mustache, grinning and holding up a big round grey rock like a treasure. The camera orbits fast. Warm daylight.
{moss} hauls a giant dented copper pot out of a cupboard and the lid clangs to the floor. The camera crash zooms in. Warm kitchen light.
{moss} hugs the giant copper pot to his chest, beaming. Low angle, the camera cranes up. Warm kitchen light.
A big copper pot lid spins on the kitchen floor like a coin. Close-up, the camera spins with it. Warm kitchen light.
{moss} carries the giant copper pot over his head toward the front door. The camera tracks backward in front of him. Warm daylight.
{moss} bonks the copper pot on the door frame and staggers. The camera whip pans. Warm daylight.
{moss} looks at the glowing phone in his hand, then at the fridge, and nods to himself. The camera pushes in fast. Warm morning light.
{moss} strides across his kitchen toward the fridge. The camera tracks with him. Warm morning light.

A black smartphone stands upright, face to the door, in a quilted moss-green brick stuck to a cream fridge door, a round sun-yellow badge with a closed eye on its front, a small shopping list held by a yellow magnet beside it. Soft leaf shadows sway slowly across the fridge door. Warm morning light. The camera pushes in slowly.
{moss} gives the fridge door a gentle pat. Close-up, the camera pushes in. Warm morning light.
{moss} sets the giant copper pot over a small fire in a sunny courtyard full of plants and fills it with a hose. The camera cranes down. Bright warm daylight.
{moss} drops a big round grey rock into the pot with a huge splash that soaks his mustache. The camera crash zooms in. Bright warm daylight.
A grandma in a purple cardigan and pearl glasses walks across the courtyard holding out one big orange carrot, one eyebrow raised. The camera tracks with her. Bright warm daylight.
A big orange carrot plops into a bubbling copper pot. Close-up, the camera pushes in. Bright warm daylight.
A tall man in an orange tracksuit with a big grey beard rolls a big orange pumpkin across the courtyard into the arms of {moss}. The camera whip pans with the pumpkin. Bright warm daylight.
{moss} staggers under the weight of a big orange pumpkin, laughing. Low angle, the camera circles him. Bright warm daylight.

Close-up: {moss} sings to the camera, his mouth opening wide under his bushy mustache, stirring a steaming copper pot with a wooden spoon, neighbours gathering behind him. The camera pushes in. Warm afternoon light.
Steam swirls up from a bubbling pot of orange soup. Top-down, the camera spins slowly. Warm afternoon light.

{moss}, a grandma in a purple cardigan and pearl glasses, a tall man in an orange tracksuit with a big grey beard and a little girl in blue overalls with a big afro puff sing together around the pot, using wooden spoons as microphones. The camera orbits fast around them. Warm afternoon light.
{moss} and a tall man in an orange tracksuit with a big grey beard clink their soup bowls together and laugh. Close-up, the camera crash zooms in. Warm afternoon light.

Close-up: {moss} sings to the camera, his mouth opening wide under his bushy mustache, at a long table in the courtyard under warm string lights. The camera slowly pulls back. Warm string-light glow at dusk.
A grandma in a purple cardigan and pearl glasses ladles soup into a bowl held up by a little girl in blue overalls with a big afro puff. Close-up, the camera pushes in. Warm string-light glow.

A long table in a plant-filled courtyard at dusk under warm string lights, neighbours laughing over soup bowls, {moss} raising his bowl at the head of the table. The camera cranes up. Warm glow against a deep blue dusk.
{moss} sets the big round grey rock back by his front door for next time and smiles. The camera pushes in slowly. Warm lantern glow.

caption: moss didn't know a single neighbour. phone in the Hibernator, one pot, one rock. now twelve floors eat together
